Run a security investigation using natural language or explicit parameters.

File analysis with human-readable output:
  trace investigate -f /path/to/file.exe

Playbook with params:
  trace investigate --playbook file-analysis --param file=/path/to/file.exe

Usage:
  trace investigate [query] [flags]

Aliases:
  investigate, inv

Flags:
  -f, --file string            Analyze a file (runs PE/hash analysis)
  -h, --help                   help for investigate
      --param stringToString   parameters for the playbook (key=value) (default [])
  -p, --playbook string        playbook name to run

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file
